steps.title: Add beads to screw tube
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 0.5 mm beads and 200 µL of 1 mm beads to a 2 mL screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Add lysis master mix
steps.instruction: Add 870 µL of Lysis master mix to the same tube (prepared in the 4 °C fridge: 225 µL TE buffer, 375 µL lysis buffer, 270 µL 10 M ammonium acetate).

steps.title: Add sample to tube
steps.instruction: Collect 20–50 mg of sample (up to 100 mg is possible but may reduce DNA quality) and add it to the 2 mL screw tube.

steps.title: Crush sample in mixmill
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a mixmill, balance tubes if needed, and run at 3200 rpm for 4 minutes (00:04:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10 × g, 25 °C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare well 1 for binding
steps.instruction: In the 1st well of a 96‑deep‑well plate, add isopropanol, magnetic beads, and lysate as described.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the magnetic‑bead bottle, then add 100 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg mL⁻¹). Re‑vortex after adding beads to every three samples to keep beads in suspension.
Transfer 300–500 µL of the cleared lysate (free of cell debris) from the 1.5 mL centrifuged tube to the well.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 2
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of isopropanol to the 2nd well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add 80 % ethanol to well 3
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to the 3rd well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add 95 % ethanol to well 4
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 95 % ethanol to the 4th well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add DEPC‑treated water to well 6
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of DEPC‑treated water to the 6th well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Load plate into extraction robot
steps.instruction: Place the prepared 96‑deep‑well plate into the automated DNA extraction machine and select the BOMB protocol.

steps.title: Pellet magnetic beads post‑extraction
steps.instruction: After the extraction run finishes, place the plate on a 96‑magnetic plate to pellet the magnetic‑bead residues.

steps.title: Add DDW to well 5
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of double‑distilled water (DDW) to the 5th well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Collect eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Collect 100 µL of the eluted sample, avoiding magnetic beads, and use it as DNA template for downstream experiments.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to well 1
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg mL⁻¹) to the 1st well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.
